claims.explanation: Dexniguldipine is a dihydropyridine P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) inhibitor/modulator, and its selective antiproliferative pattern is best explained by ABCB1 expression: lines with high ABCB1 efflux activity are sensitized because dexniguldipine blocks P-gp-mediated drug efflux and/or perturbs P-gp-dependent lipid/phosphatidylserine transport, while low-ABCB1 lines are unaffected. The virtual-cell signature (G2/M and DNA-replication gene suppression, calcineurin/immunosuppressant-like similarity) supports a P-gp/calcineurin-adjacent mechanism rather than a simple ADORA3 effect.

features.basis: dexniguldipine is a second-generation P-gp inhibitor/modulator; P-gp-expressing lines are the intended target
activating/amplified MDR1 would increase P-gp substrate efflux and dependence on dexniguldipine modulation
TP53-mutant lines dominate the selectively killed set, consistent with loss of apoptosis/DNA-damage checkpoints enhancing sensitivity to P-gp/calcineurin-linked stress
PTEN loss co-occurs in many killed lines and may increase dependence on PI3K/AKT and P-gp-associated survival signaling
BRAF-mutant melanoma/colorectal/endometrial lines are enriched among killed lines, suggesting MAPK-driven P-gp/efflux dependence
EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines (HCC4006, NCIH1650) are selectively killed, possibly via EGFR-driven ABCB1 expression
PIK3CA-mutant lines appear in the killed set and may rely on PI3K signaling that intersects with P-gp regulation
NF1 loss activates RAS/MAPK and is enriched in killed lines, potentially increasing ABCB1-dependent efflux
ARID1A-mutant lines are overrepresented among killed lines, suggesting chromatin-remodeling loss alters drug-efflux or stress responses
KMT2D mutations recur in killed lines and may reflect a permissive chromatin state for ABCB1 or stress-pathway expression
KRAS-mutant pancreatic/colorectal/ovarian lines are enriched among least-affected lines, suggesting KRAS-driven resistance to P-gp modulation
FBXW7-mutant lines appear in the least-affected set, possibly via stabilized oncoproteins that bypass dexniguldipine-induced stress
